desc: Read input values $N$, arrays $A$ and $B$, $K$, and the $K$ query pairs $(X_k, Y_k)$.
Sort arrays $A$ and $B$ in non-decreasing order.
Compute prefix sum arrays for both sorted $A$ and sorted $B$ to allow $O(1)$ range sum queries.
Implement the Segment Tree classes (or functions) for Range Add / Range Sum and Range Add / Range Weighted Sum.
Implement the offline query processing loop.
